# KVmEmptyStale's `pop` leaves the cache as it was (tests/refine-mutant.py vm-empty-stale): a wrong
# optimization. Its parts at a translation are open: popping the last element leaves the cache
# saying nonempty, so the translation of `KVmEmpty`'s result is not what `KVmEmptyStale` reaches.
# The underflow rules, which read the cache, are generated by the generic attempts under the
# invariant that the cache is right (`--invariant-unfold`), as in VmEmptyRefine. Refuted together
# by `stale-pop`'s runs (`Open.refuted`, Witnesses.lean), from an initial configuration, which
# satisfies the invariant.

bwd_tr.«pop»
